Crime & Law · India

Two migrant workers killed in Kulgam terror attack

A targeted terror attack in Kulgam, South Kashmir, resulted in the deaths of two migrant workers from Chhattisgarh. One victim died immediately, while the second succumbed to injuries later. Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah announced an ex gratia payment of Rs 10 lakh for the families of the deceased. Security forces are investigating the incident, with initial reports suggesting a Lashkar commander may be involved. Political leaders have condemned the attack, with some calling it a security lapse and questioning its timing.
